method: Static TypeScript AST and source-text inspection only; no ADH module imported and no device/service calls. Endpoint coverage is syntactic, not proof of execution or semantic parity.

handlerCalls:
['# ADH MCP Tools', '', `Generated from the live ADH Daemon registry (${MCP_TOOLS.length} tools). Endpoint: \`POST /mcp\` (JSON-RPC 2.0).`, '',
        '| Tool | Description | Args |', '|---|---|---|',
        ...MCP_TOOLS.map(t => `| \`${t.name}\` | ${cell(t.description)} | ${cell(Object.keys(t.inputSchema.properties ?? {}).join(', ') || '—')} |`), ''].join

limitations: Tool/route presence is static, not live availability or passing integration evidence.
Literal UI references omit dynamic API expressions; neither fetch count nor string references prove a rendered control.
Route method * means no method property in the table; handlers may still branch by method.
Handler calls and direct agent ops are lexical within that handler, not a transitive execution graph.
Package-pinned /<package>/mcp and dashboard fallbacks are router branches outside the 106 static route entries.

validation.isolation: ADH_SKIP_ARTIFACT_LOAD=1 and inherited ADH_DATA_DIR removed in child shell; existing launcher assigns per-test-process temporary data roots. No live service/device calls or dynamic ADH imports for inventory.
validation.scope: Static audit plus unchanged Host regression suite, not device/USB/LAN integration acceptance.
